title: Magnus Quit Because of Jeans
post: Magnus Carlsen quit the World Championship because of his jeans. Then FIDE changed the rule, he came back in jeans and shared the world title. And the jeans sold for $36,100. Would you have changed? #chess #magnuscarlsen #chesstok #fide #jeans

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Magnus Carlsen quit the World Championship.
phrases.say: [serious] Magnus Carlsen quit the World Championship...

phrases.text: New York, December 2024. Magnus shows up to the World Rapid Championship in jeans.
phrases.say: New York, December twenty twenty-four. Magnus shows up to the World Rapid Championship... in jeans.

phrases.text: But the dress code says: no jeans.
phrases.say: But the dress code says... no jeans.

phrases.text: The arbiter fines him 200 dollars and tells him to change. Right now.
phrases.say: The arbiter fines him two hundred dollars, and tells him to change. Right now.

phrases.text: FIDE says no. So he isn't paired for the next round.
phrases.say: FIDE says no. So he isn't paired for the next round.

phrases.text: And Magnus just walks out. Of the whole championship.
phrases.say: [laughs] And Magnus just walks out... of the whole championship.

phrases.text: Two days later, FIDE backs down. Jeans are now allowed.
phrases.say: Two days later... FIDE backs down. Jeans are now allowed.

phrases.text: He reaches the blitz final against Ian Nepomniachtchi.
phrases.say: He reaches the blitz final... against Ian Nepomniachtchi.

phrases.text: So Magnus asks: can we just share the title? And FIDE says yes.
phrases.say: So Magnus asks... can we just share the title? [surprised] And FIDE says yes.

phrases.text: The first shared world title in chess history.
phrases.say: The first shared world title in chess history.

phrases.text: And the jeans? He sold them on eBay. For 36,100 dollars. For charity.
phrases.say: And the jeans? He sold them on eBay... for thirty-six thousand, one hundred dollars. For charity.

phrases.text: Would you have changed? Follow for more.
phrases.say: [playful] Would you have changed? Follow for more.
